comment: Dr. Robbins was an amazing FYS professor. Her psychology class inspired me to take more in the department. The assignments were manageable, with clear expectations. Her office hours were super helpful, and she encouraged participation and got to know everyone. She's also flexible with due dates and attendance when needed.

I wasn't expecting this class to be so fun, but it was one of the best I've taken at UR! Dr. Robbins is smart, engaging, and gives you everything you need to get a good grade. I wish I can take another class with her!

The nature of this course makes it very reading and lecture heavy. You can get away with not reading the textbook if you pay attention in lecture. Prof is super nice and understanding. Wants you to succeed, is very flexible/accessible outside of class. 3 exams and optional final. Final project is a group project worked on throughout semester.

Dr. Robbins is one of the most understanding professor I have ever met. The PSYC 200 content is mostly about AP Statistic, which means if you take that before, you can certainly get A here. Anyway, She is the most amazing  professor I've met, and she can offer you help in your life. Just reach for her.
